titre: He took your knight. Recapture? Look first! ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Nimzo-Indian trap: White grabs your knight. Taking back is only equal. Instead, the pinned knight falls with check, the queen forks king and rook, and you recapture later: a full rook up. Seen in 3 real Lichess games. Would you have recaptured? 👇
